uris.description: Only these game URIs. A game that already has a slug gets it copied to its search document if that is missing it. Without uris, the job walks every game that has no slug.

dryRun.description: Choose slugs and compare search documents, but write nothing. Pass false to write.

maxGames.description: Stop after this many games, for a trial run.

status.description: The existing job's status, when alreadyQueued is true.

alreadyQueued.description: True when a backfill was already pending or running; jobId is that job, and nothing new was queued.

main.description: Queue a job that gives games with no slug one, and puts the slug on their search document. Existing slugs are never changed. A dry run unless dryRun is false. Admins and the maintenance account only. One backfill runs at a time.
